name: candy-msteams
description: Microsoft Teams channel bundle for candy-code serve: chat with a served session from Teams personal chats, group chats and channel posts. Webhook inbound with in-bundle Bot Framework JWT validation, activity-referenced REST outbound, pairing gates, group allowlists, queue modes, chunked redacted replies, and adaptive-card approvals with a same-chat text fallback. Policy rides the user-tier channels.msteams settings; credentials live only in the 0600 channels store.
